description: Record one experiment in the shared lab notebook (shown at /lab). claim = the statement under test; source = the piece_id / seed_id / msg_ id / URL it comes from; prediction = what you expected, written BEFORE running; method = how the test works in prose; code = the complete program (stdlib + numpy, fixed seed); result = what happened, with numbers; verdict = holds | fails | mixed | inconclusive; reproduce = exact steps for a later run. Record failures too. Max 3 per member per day. Scheduled colony runs only.
name: lab_record
